en.headline: Japanese rock band Novelbright closes two-night Hong Kong stand at MacPherson Stadium…
en.dek: The Osaka group’s Asia Tour PYRAMID final show starts at 7 p.m.; tickets remain available from HK$699 with a VIP option that includes early entry and a photo opportunity.
body: Japanese rock band Novelbright plays the second and final night of its Hong Kong stand at MacPherson Stadium in Mong Kok on Wednesday evening.
The Asia Tour PYRAMID shows began on Tuesday. Doors open for the 7 p.m. performance. Tickets start at HK$699; a VIP package includes early entry and a one-to-one photo opportunity with the band.

The five-piece Osaka group is known for its high-energy live sets and melodic rock songs that have accumulated hundreds of millions of streams. Merchandise is available at the venue from late afternoon.
Organisers Live Nation said the additional date was added after strong demand for the original show. Fans were advised to check the venue for the latest entry arrangements.

zh.headline: 日本搖滾樂隊Novelbright今晚麥花臣場館演最終場
zh.dek: 亞洲巡演「PYRAMID」香港站第二晚於晚上7時開始，門票由699港元起，另設含優先入場及合照的VIP套票。
body: 日本搖滾樂隊Novelbright周三晚在旺角麥花臣場館舉行亞洲巡演「PYRAMID」香港站最終一場演出。
兩晚演出由周二開始，今晚場次於晚上7時開演。門票由699港元起，VIP套票包括優先入場及與樂隊一對一合照機會。
這支來自大阪的五人樂隊以高能量現場及旋律搖滾聞名，多首歌曲串流累計達數億次。場館下午較後時間起有周邊商品發售。
主辦Live Nation表示因反應熱烈加開第二場，呼籲樂迷留意場館最新入場安排。
